name: Better WARP
description: Cloudflare WARP over AmneziaWG as a protocol of the subscription: each subscriber gets WARP nodes in the same four forms as an AmneziaWG node (vpn://, amneziawg://, the older amneziawg:// link, .conf), with their own WARP device, junk-packet settings, a WARP+ license, and a check and an endpoint scanner (to find the quickest endpoints) that run in Better Cores.
author: AllIsA1
